profile_headline: Data Scientist | Craves to Learn | Loves to Solve | Lives to teach
post_content:
To aspiring data scientists in my network ,      I know you have completed 2-3
MOOCs  and have done a couple of projects. I see many of you spending endless
hours searching/hunting for a job.     Shift you focus to excellence. Chase it
like a hungry lion. Achieve perfection. When I say perfection, it's not about
practising until you get it right.     Perfection is practising until you
CAN'T get it wrong !!     Yes, hunger is painful. Take the pain. Raise your
threshold. Fight it.  So now you will ask me - How   ? Just imagine, two years
down the lane, you visit the cosiest restaurant of the town and tickle your
taste buds WITHOUT looking at right hand side of menu !!  This should motivate
you ! Or something else as per your taste If you think this imagination is too
small for me , then "Boy, You are on the way "
